mapper.insert: INSERT INTO iam_subject (id, display_name, status) VALUES (#{subject.id}, #{subject.displayName}, #{subject.status})
mapper.update: UPDATE iam_subject SET display_name = #{displayName}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, version = version + 1 WHERE id = #{subjectId} AND version = #{version} AND deleted = 0
UPDATE iam_subject SET status = #{status}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, version = version + 1 WHERE id = #{subjectId} AND version = #{version} AND deleted = 0
UPDATE iam_subject SET status = 'DISABLED', deleted = 1, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, version = version + 1 WHERE id = #{subjectId} AND version = #{version} AND deleted = 0

WITH account_ids AS MATERIALIZED ( SELECT id FROM iam_account WHERE subject_id = #{subjectId} AND deleted = 0 ), isolated_credentials AS ( UPDATE iam_credential SET status = 'DISABLED', deleted = 1, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, version = version + 1 WHERE account_id IN (SELECT id FROM account_ids) AND deleted = 0 ), isolated_identifiers AS ( UPDATE iam_account_identifier SET status = 'DISABLED', deleted = 1, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, version = version + 1 WHERE account_id IN (SELECT id FROM account_ids) AND deleted = 0 ), isolated_contacts AS ( UPDATE iam_contact SET status = 'DISABLED', deleted = 1, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, version = version + 1 WHERE subject_id = #{subjectId} AND deleted = 0 ) UPDATE iam_account SET status = 'DISABLED', deleted = 1, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, version = version + 1 WHERE id IN (SELECT id FROM account_ids)
mapper.select: SELECT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM iam_principal principal WHERE principal.subject_id = #{subjectId} AND principal.principal_type IN ('PLATFORM', 'TENANT') AND principal.status = 'ACTIVE' AND principal.deleted = 0 AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM iam_account account WHERE account.subject_id = principal.subject_id AND account.id <> #{excludedAccountId} AND account.status = 'ACTIVE' AND account.deleted = 0 AND ( (principal.principal_type = 'PLATFORM' AND account.scope_type = 'GLOBAL') OR (principal.principal_type = 'TENANT' AND ( account.scope_type = 'GLOBAL' OR (account.scope_type = 'TENANT' AND account.scope_id = principal.tenant_id) )) ) ) )
mapper.update: WITH isolated_credentials AS ( UPDATE iam_credential SET status = 'DISABLED', deleted = 1, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, version = version + 1 WHERE account_id = #{accountId} AND deleted = 0 ), isolated_identifiers AS ( UPDATE iam_account_identifier SET status = 'DISABLED', deleted = 1, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, version = version + 1 WHERE account_id = #{accountId} AND deleted = 0 ) UPDATE iam_account SET status = 'DISABLED', deleted = 1, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, version = version + 1 WHERE id = #{accountId} AND version = #{version} AND deleted = 0
UPDATE iam_principal SET status = 'DISABLED', deleted = 1, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, version = version + 1 WHERE subject_id = #{subjectId} AND deleted = 0
UPDATE iam_tenant_membership SET status = 'DISABLED', deleted = 1, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, version = version + 1 WHERE subject_id = #{subjectId} AND deleted = 0
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO iam_cleanup_task (id, task_type, resource_id) VALUES (#{taskId}, 'SUBJECT', #{subjectId}) ON CONFLICT (task_type, resource_id) DO NOTHING
mapper.select: WITH claimed AS ( SELECT id FROM iam_cleanup_task WHERE task_type = 'SUBJECT' AND (status = 'PENDING' OR (status = 'PROCESSING' AND updated_at < CURRENT_TIMESTAMP - INTERVAL '5 minutes')) ORDER BY created_at, id FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED LIMIT #{limit} ) UPDATE iam_cleanup_task task SET status = 'PROCESSING', attempts = attempts + 1, last_error = NULL, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE task.id IN (SELECT id FROM claimed) RETURNING task.id AS task_id, task.resource_id AS subject_id
SELECT id FROM iam_principal WHERE subject_id = #{subjectId} AND deleted = 1 ORDER BY id
mapper.update: UPDATE iam_cleanup_task SET status = 'COMPLETED', updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{taskId} AND status = 'PROCESSING'
UPDATE iam_cleanup_task SET status = 'PENDING', last_error = #{error}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{taskId} AND status = 'PROCESSING'
mapper.select: WITH claimed AS ( SELECT id FROM iam_cleanup_task WHERE task_type = 'TENANT' AND (status = 'PENDING' OR (status = 'PROCESSING' AND updated_at < CURRENT_TIMESTAMP - INTERVAL '5 minutes')) ORDER BY created_at, id FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED LIMIT #{limit} ) UPDATE iam_cleanup_task task SET status = 'PROCESSING', attempts = attempts + 1, last_error = NULL, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE task.id IN (SELECT id FROM claimed) RETURNING task.id AS task_id, task.resource_id AS tenant_id
SELECT DISTINCT subject_id FROM iam_tenant_membership WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND deleted = 0 ORDER BY subject_id
mapper.update: UPDATE iam_principal SET status = #{status}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, version = version + 1 WHERE id = #{principalId} AND version = #{version} AND deleted = 0
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO iam_tenant (id, code, name, tenant_type, status) VALUES (#{tenant.id}, #{tenant.code}, #{tenant.name}, #{tenant.tenantType}, #{tenant.status})
mapper.select: WITH locked_tenant AS ( SELECT id, code FROM iam_tenant WHERE id = #{tenantId} AND version = #{version} AND deleted = 0 FOR UPDATE ), updated_tenant AS ( UPDATE iam_tenant tenant SET code = #{code}, name = #{name}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, version = tenant.version + 1 FROM locked_tenant WHERE tenant.id = locked_tenant.id RETURNING locked_tenant.code ) SELECT code FROM updated_tenant
mapper.update: UPDATE iam_tenant SET status = #{status}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, version = version + 1 WHERE id = #{tenantId} AND version = #{version} AND deleted = 0
mapper.select: SELECT status FROM iam_tenant WHERE id = #{tenantId} AND deleted = 0 FOR SHARE

SELECT membership.id AS membership_id, p.id AS principal_id, t.id AS tenant_id, t.code AS tenant_code, t.name AS tenant_name, t.tenant_type, t.status AS tenant_status, membership.status AS membership_status, membership.version FROM iam_tenant_membership membership INNER JOIN iam_principal p ON p.membership_id = membership.id AND p.principal_type = 'TENANT' AND p.deleted = 0 INNER JOIN iam_tenant t ON t.id = membership.tenant_id AND t.deleted = 0 WHERE membership.subject_id = #{subjectId} AND membership.deleted = 0 AND p.deleted = 0 ORDER BY t.name, t.id
